name: Dian
source: The Amazon queen Dian of Limtinia is a martial paragon. She is considered by many to be one of the best strategists on the continent, able to match and overcome the most brilliant generals. She is also a very pious queen, worshipping The Chieftain and following his rituals strictly.
translation: The Amazon queen Dian of Limtinia is a martial paragon. She is considered by many to be one of the best strategists on the continent, able to match and overcome the most brilliant generals. She is also a very pious queen, worshipping The Chieftain and following his rituals strictly.
